# IngredientManifest

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public record IngredientManifest : ISchemaVersioned
```

One layer, or trait-category: a kind, how it is colored, and its weighted variants.

## Constructors

### IngredientManifest(string, string, LayerKind, Colorization?, IReadOnlyList&lt;Variant&gt;, int, bool) { #m-ctor-system-string-system-string-nfty-core-model-layer-ad3ca7 }

```csharp
public IngredientManifest(string Id, string Name, LayerKind Kind, Colorization? Colorization, IReadOnlyList<Variant> Variants, int SchemaVersion = 2, bool PartialAlpha = false);
```

**Parameters**

- `Id` (`string`) - Stable identifier, unique within its Recipe. Becomes the archive entry name.
- `Name` (`string`) - Display name. Also the trait type published in the asset metadata, which is why `Validator` reserves the name "Type" — that is the Recipe's own pseudo-trait.
- `Kind` (`LayerKind`) - Whether the layer rolls a color, applies one fixed color, or is composited as-is; see [`LayerKind`](Nfty.Core.Model.LayerKind.md).
- `Colorization` (`Colorization?`) - How a Dynamic or Static layer is colored. Must be null for [`LayerKind.Custom`](Nfty.Core.Model.LayerKind.md#f-custom), and must be present for the other two.
- `Variants` (`IReadOnlyList<Variant>`) - The weighted images this layer can roll.
- `SchemaVersion` (`int`) - The manifest format version; see [`Schema`](Nfty.Core.Model.Schema.md).
- `PartialAlpha` (`bool`) - Whether any variant under this manifest carries a partial-alpha pixel — the book-level value is what the UI calls "2D only". A listing cache: writers stamp it from the pixels on every write, and anything that decoded the pixels recomputes it rather than reading it.
